title: K-2SO
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
franchise: Rogue One: A Star Wars story
description: K-2SO (called Kay-two by Cassian Andor) was a reprogrammed Imperial Security Droid. He came in handy when infiltrating Imperial installations or blending in on planets that were under Imperial occupation. With his reprogramming, he had a tendency to say whatever came into his circuits, no matter how rude or direct. He always wanted a blaster and was disappointed Cassian wouldn't let him have one.
